 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Topstories News DTI, FDA execs subpoenaed as defense witnesses in Sara Duterte impeachment trial 
 By GISELLE OMBAY , GMA News Published November 16, 2026 1:42pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. The Senate impeachment court has issued subpoenas to the witnesses who will be next presented by the defense panel in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on November 19 and 20, Senate Secretary Renato Bantug Jr. said on Monday. 
 According to Bantug, the subpoenas have been sent electronically.
 In its request for subpoenas, the defense identified the prospective witnesses for November 19 and 20 as: 
 Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente of AML Consulting PH, who "will testify on fundamental legal concepts relating to the Anti-Money Laundering Act";
 Dr. Ceferino S. Rodolfo, the Department of Trade and Industry's Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group, who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's registration with the Board of Investments";
 Pilar Marilyn M. Pagayunan, MBA, Director IV of the Center for Food Regulation and Research of the Food and Drug Administration, who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation's product registration for its sweetened banana chips"; and
 Rowena G. Mendoza, General Manager III and/or any representative from the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM), who "will testify on matters relating to Cale88 Foods Corporation communications, such as, but not limited to, electronic mail correspondences sent by CITEM to Cale88 and other invitations to the corporation for food expositions."
 Defense counsel Michael Poa earlier said that their team is planning to present 8 to 10 more witnesses in the impeachment trial. –NB, GMA News
